summary: Stocks are rallying midday with the Nasdaq up and the VIX down 4.1% as dip buying resumes. Tesla leads the watchlist at 3.43% higher on SpaceX tech-rally headlines, while AMD and Meta climb with the broader tape and GOOGL lags.
